title: Tool presets: save/apply named setting combos (epic)
description:
# Epic: Generic tool presets (save/apply named setting combos)

## Goal

Let users save the current settings of a tool under a name and re-apply them later, with export/share/import as `.itpreset` files. Build ONE reusable infrastructure (domain + data + UI), then wire it into two tools: OCR (feature/recognize-text) and AI Tools (feature/ai-tools).

## Why not reuse ImageExportProfile?

`core/domain/.../image/model/ImageExportProfile.kt` + `ImageExportProfilesUseCase` already implement this UX but are hardcoded to resize/export settings (`ImageInfo`, `Preset`, keepExif, background color). Resize & Convert is already fully covered by it and MUST NOT be changed. The new system is a generalization for arbitrary per-tool payloads and lives alongside the old one.

## Architecture (mirror the existing, proven pattern)

- Domain (pure Kotlin, `core/domain`): `ToolPreset<T>`, `ToolPresetsUseCase<T>`, `ToolPresetsUseCaseFactory` — modeled on `ImageExportProfilesUseCase`.
- Data (`core/data`): DataStore-backed impl, JSON via injected `JsonParser` (Moshi), one preferences key per tool (`TOOL_PRESETS_<toolKey>`); factory caches instances per toolKey. Modeled on `ImageExportProfilesUseCaseImpl`.
- UI (`core/ui`): `ToolPresetsHolder<T>` interface (delegation pattern like `ImageExportProfilesHolder`) + `ToolPresetSelector` composable (chip + bottom sheet, like `ImageExportProfileSelector`).
- Feature wiring: each tool defines a Moshi-safe payload data class (primitives/String/List/Map only), delegates `ToolPresetsHolder`, overrides save/apply, and drops `ToolPresetSelector` into its Content composable.

## Hard rules for all child issues

- Payload classes may ONLY contain: Boolean, Int, Long, Float, Double, String, nullable versions, and List/Map of those. NO sealed classes, NO enums (store enum `.name` as String), NO classes with private constructors (e.g. `TessParams`). This guarantees Moshi round-trips without custom adapters.
- Exported preset files use a JSON envelope `{toolKey, version, name, payload}` where payload is an embedded JSON string; import MUST reject files whose `toolKey` does not match and surface a toast.
- Copy the Apache license header (from any neighboring file, year 2026) into every new file.
- Do not modify anything under feature/resize-convert.

## Child issues (implementation order)

1. Domain models + interfaces (core/domain)
2. Data impl + Hilt binding (core/data)
3. String resources (core/resources)
4. UI holder + selector composable (core/ui)
5. Wire into OCR (feature/recognize-text)
6. Wire into AI Tools (feature/ai-tools)
7. Final verification build + manual QA checklist

# Domain layer for generic tool presets (core/domain)

Create the domain model and interfaces for the tool presets system. Pure Kotlin, no Android imports. This mirrors the existing `ImageExportProfilesUseCase` pattern (read `core/domain/src/main/kotlin/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/core/domain/image/ImageExportProfilesUseCase.kt` for style reference).

## Files to CREATE (exactly these paths)

### 1. `core/domain/src/main/kotlin/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/core/domain/presets/ToolPreset.kt`

```kotlin
package com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.core.domain.presets

data class ToolPreset<T : Any>(
    val name: String,
    val payload: T,
    val version: Int = 1
)
```

### 2. `core/domain/src/main/kotlin/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/core/domain/presets/ToolPresetImportResult.kt`

```kotlin
package com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.core.domain.presets

sealed interface ToolPresetImportResult {
    data object Success : ToolPresetImportResult
    data object WrongTool : ToolPresetImportResult
    data object Invalid : ToolPresetImportResult
}
```

### 3. `core/domain/src/main/kotlin/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/core/domain/presets/ToolPresetsUseCase.kt`

```kotlin
package com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.core.domain.presets

import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow

interface ToolPresetsUseCase<T : Any> {

    val presets: Flow<List<ToolPreset<T>>>

    suspend fun upsert(preset: ToolPreset<T>)

    suspend fun delete(preset: ToolPreset<T>)

    suspend fun export(
        preset: ToolPreset<T>,
        uri: String
    )

    suspend fun share(preset: ToolPreset<T>)

    suspend fun import(uri: String): ToolPresetImportResult

}
```

### 4. `core/domain/src/main/kotlin/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/core/domain/presets/ToolPresetsUseCaseFactory.kt`

```kotlin
package com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.core.domain.presets

interface ToolPresetsUseCaseFactory {

    /**
     * Returns the ToolPresetsUseCase for [toolKey]. MUST return the same cached
     * instance when called twice with the same [toolKey] (components rely on this
     * for interface delegation).
     *
     * [payloadType] is the concrete payload class used for JSON (de)serialization.
     * Payload classes must only contain primitives, Strings and List/Map of those.
     */
    fun <T : Any> create(
        toolKey: String,
        payloadType: Class<T>
    ): ToolPresetsUseCase<T>

}
```

## Rules

- Add the Apache 2.0 license header found at the top of `core/domain/src/main/kotlin/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/core/domain/image/ImageExportProfilesUseCase.kt` to each new file (copyright year 2026).
- Do NOT modify any existing file.
- No Android/AndroidX imports; only `kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow` is allowed as external dependency.

## Verification

```
./gradlew :core:domain:compileKotlin 2>&1 | tail -20
```

If that task name does not exist, discover the correct one via `./gradlew :core:domain:tasks --all | grep -i compile` and run the main compile task. Build must succeed with no errors.

## Acceptance criteria

- All 4 files exist at exactly the paths above with the exact public API shown.
- core/domain compiles.
- No existing files changed.

description:
# Wire tool presets into OCR (feature/recognize-text)

Add save/apply presets to the Recognize Text tool using the generic infra (domain/data/UI issues must be done first).

REQUIRED READING:
- `feature/recognize-text/src/main/java/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/feature/recognize/text/presentation/screenLogic/RecognizeTextComponent.kt` — the component being modified (constructor at line ~101; setters at lines 595-624 `setRecognitionType`/`setRecognitionEngine`/`setPaddleOCRModel`, 689 `onLanguagesSelected`, 710 `setSegmentationMode`, 817-837 `toggleContrastFilter`/`toggleThresholdFilter`/`toggleSharpnessFilter`/`setOcrEngineMode`, 1095 `updateParams`).
- `feature/recognize-text/src/main/java/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/feature/recognize/text/domain/TessParams.kt` — NOTE: `TessParams` has a PRIVATE constructor and `Any`-typed values; it CANNOT be serialized directly. The payload stores it as `Map<String, String>` + custom string (see below).
- `feature/resize-convert/src/main/java/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/feature/resize_convert/presentation/screenLogic/ResizeAndConvertComponent.kt` lines 88-96 — reference for the delegation pattern (`ImageExportProfilesHolder by ImageExportProfilesHolder(...)` using `componentContext.coroutineScope` imported from `com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.core.ui.utils.navigation.coroutineScope`).

## Step 1: CREATE payload class

`feature/recognize-text/src/main/java/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/feature/recognize/text/domain/OcrPresetPayload.kt`

```kotlin
package com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.feature.recognize.text.domain

data class OcrPresetPayload(
    val recognitionType: String = "",
    val recognitionEngine: String = "",
    val paddleOCRModel: String = "",
    val segmentationMode: String = "",
    val ocrEngineMode: String = "",
    val languageCodes: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val tessParams: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(),
    val tessCustomParams: String = "",
    val contrastFilterEnabled: Boolean = false,
    val thresholdFilterEnabled: Boolean = false,
    val sharpnessFilterEnabled: Boolean = false
)
```

(Only primitives/String/List/Map — Moshi-safe by design. Enum fields store `.name`.)

Also add a constant for the tool key in this file:

```kotlin
const val OCR_PRESETS_TOOL_KEY = "recognize_text"
```

## Step 2: MODIFY `RecognizeTextComponent.kt`

### 2a. Constructor + delegation

- Add constructor parameter (non-assisted, Hilt provides it): `toolPresetsUseCaseFactory: ToolPresetsUseCaseFactory` (import `com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.core.domain.presets.ToolPresetsUseCaseFactory`).
- The component currently extends `BaseComponent(dispatchersHolder, componentContext)` (check exact supertype call). Append a delegation clause after the supertype:

```kotlin
) : BaseComponent(dispatchersHolder, componentContext),
    ToolPresetsHolder<OcrPresetPayload> by ToolPresetsHolder(
        useCase = toolPresetsUseCaseFactory.create(
            toolKey = OCR_PRESETS_TOOL_KEY,
            payloadType = OcrPresetPayload::class.java
        ),
        componentScope = componentContext.coroutineScope
    ) {
```

Imports needed: `com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.core.ui.utils.ToolPresetsHolder`, `com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.core.domain.presets.ToolPreset`, `com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.core.ui.utils.navigation.coroutineScope` (check whether this import already exists in the file). The factory caches per toolKey, so calling `create` again inside the class body returns the same instance:

```kotlin
private val ocrPresetsUseCase = toolPresetsUseCaseFactory.create(
    toolKey = OCR_PRESETS_TOOL_KEY,
    payloadType = OcrPresetPayload::class.java
)
```

For this, change the constructor param from plain parameter to `private val toolPresetsUseCaseFactory: ToolPresetsUseCaseFactory` OR just declare the `ocrPresetsUseCase` val directly from the parameter (parameter is visible in property initializers). Either works; prefer the val-from-parameter form without storing the factory.

### 2b. Override save

Add to the class body:

```kotlin
override fun saveToolPreset(name: String) {
    componentScope.launch {
        ocrPresetsUseCase.upsert(
            ToolPreset(
                name = name,
                payload = capturePresetPayload()
            )
        )
    }
}

private fun capturePresetPayload(): OcrPresetPayload = OcrPresetPayload(
    recognitionType = recognitionType.name,
    recognitionEngine = recognitionEngine.name,
    paddleOCRModel = paddleOCRModel.name,
    segmentationMode = segmentationMode.name,
    ocrEngineMode = ocrEngineMode.name,
    languageCodes = selectedLanguages.map { it.code },
    tessParams = params.tessParamList.associate { it.key to it.stringValue },
    tessCustomParams = params.tessCustomParams,
    contrastFilterEnabled = filtersAdded.contains(contrastFilterInstance),
    thresholdFilterEnabled = filtersAdded.contains(thresholdFilterInstance),
    sharpnessFilterEnabled = filtersAdded.contains(sharpenFilterInstance)
)
```

CHECK the actual property names before writing: the enums are exposed as `recognitionType`, `recognitionEngine`, `paddleOCRModel`, `segmentationMode`, `ocrEngineMode`, tess params as `params`, filters as `filtersAdded`, and the filter instances as `contrastFilterInstance` / `thresholdFilterInstance` / `sharpenFilterInstance` (see toggle functions at lines 817-833 — use exactly the same instance fields they use; if they are private that is fine, this code is inside the class).

### 2c. Override apply

```kotlin
override fun applyToolPreset(preset: ToolPreset<OcrPresetPayload>) {
    val payload = preset.payload

    payload.recognitionType.toEnumOrNull<RecognitionType>()?.let(::setRecognitionType)
    payload.recognitionEngine.toEnumOrNull<RecognitionEngine>()?.let(::setRecognitionEngine)
    payload.paddleOCRModel.toEnumOrNull<PaddleOCRModel>()?.let(::setPaddleOCRModel)
    payload.segmentationMode.toEnumOrNull<SegmentationMode>()?.let(::setSegmentationMode)
    payload.ocrEngineMode.toEnumOrNull<OcrEngineMode>()?.let(::setOcrEngineMode)

    if (payload.languageCodes.isNotEmpty()) {
        val resolved = languages.filter { it.code in payload.languageCodes }
        if (resolved.isNotEmpty()) onLanguagesSelected(resolved)
    }

    var newParams = TessParams.Default
    payload.tessParams.forEach { (key, stored) ->
        newParams = newParams.update(key) { old ->
            when (old) {
                is Boolean -> stored == "1" || stored.equals("true", ignoreCase = true)
                is Int -> stored.toIntOrNull() ?: old
                else -> old
            }
        }
    }
    updateParams(newParams.update(newCustomParams = payload.tessCustomParams))

    if (filtersAdded.contains(contrastFilterInstance) != payload.contrastFilterEnabled) toggleContrastFilter()
    if (filtersAdded.contains(thresholdFilterInstance) != payload.thresholdFilterEnabled) toggleThresholdFilter()
    if (filtersAdded.contains(sharpenFilterInstance) != payload.sharpnessFilterEnabled) toggleSharpnessFilter()
}

private inline fun <reified E : Enum<E>> String.toEnumOrNull(): E? =
    runCatching { enumValueOf<E>(this) }.getOrNull()
```

NOTES:
- `TessParams.update(newCustomParams = ...)` — check the actual signature in TessParams.kt line 82: `fun update(newCustomParams: String)`. Call it accordingly.
- Guard against enum name mismatch with `toEnumOrNull` (imported presets from other app versions).
- `updateParams` exists at line 1095: `fun updateParams(newParams: TessParams)` — verify its actual signature and adapt.

## Step 3: MODIFY the content composable

`feature/recognize-text/src/main/java/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/feature/recognize/text/presentation/RecognizeTextContent.kt`

Read the file; inside the controls column (where `RecognitionTypeSelector` / OCR settings widgets are placed — locate the Column listing setting controls), add:

```kotlin
ToolPresetSelector(holder = component)
```

with import `com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.core.ui.widget.controls.selection.ToolPresetSelector`. Place it as the FIRST control in the settings column, followed by the existing controls. Match surrounding spacing (if siblings are separated by `Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))` or a spacedBy arrangement, follow suit).

## Verification

```
./gradlew :feature:recognize-text:compileMarketDebugKotlin 2>&1 | tail -30
```

(Find exact task name via `./gradlew :feature:recognize-text:tasks --all | grep -i compile` if needed.) Must compile.

Check the module's build.gradle: feature modules already depend on core:ui and core:domain via the convention plugin (`feature/resize-convert` uses `ImageExportProfilesHolder` from core:ui the same way), so NO build.gradle changes should be needed. If unresolved references occur, compare with feature/resize-convert's build.gradle.

## Acceptance criteria

- `OcrPresetPayload.kt` created; component delegates `ToolPresetsHolder<OcrPresetPayload>`, overrides `saveToolPreset`/`applyToolPreset` as above; selector visible in content.
- Module compiles.
- No files outside feature/recognize-text modified.
close_reason: Created OcrPresetPayload + OCR_PRESETS_TOOL_KEY; wired ToolPresetsHolder<OcrPresetPayload> delegation into RecognizeTextComponent with saveToolPreset/applyToolPreset overrides; added ToolPresetSelector to RecognizeTextControls. feature:recognize-text:compileMarketDebugKotlin succeeds. No files outside feature/recognize-text modified for this task

# Wire tool presets into AI Tools (feature/ai-tools)

Add save/apply presets to the AI Tools screen using the generic infra (domain/data/UI issues must be done first).

REQUIRED READING:
- `feature/ai-tools/src/main/java/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/feature/ai_tools/presentation/screenLogic/AiToolsComponent.kt` — component to modify. Key facts: constructor is `@AssistedInject` ending at line ~83 with supertype `BaseComponent(dispatchersHolder, componentContext)`; `selectedModel: StateFlow<NeuralModel?>` (line 115); `params: NeuralParams` via `_params` savable (lines 121-125); `imageFormat: ImageFormat?` (127-128); `selectModel(model)` (151); `updateParams(action: NeuralParams.() -> NeuralParams)` (214); `setImageFormat(imageFormat: ImageFormat?)` (460); `downloadedModels: StateFlow<List<NeuralModel>>` (105).
- `feature/ai-tools/src/main/java/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/feature/ai_tools/domain/model/NeuralModel.kt` — `NeuralModel` has `val name: String` (unique file name, line 27) and `NeuralModel.entries` (line 83). Also read the `NeuralParams` definition (find it in the same domain package; fields: `strength: Float`, `chunkSize: Int`, `overlap: Int`, `enableChunking: Boolean`, `parallelWorkers: Int` — verify exact names).
- `core/domain/src/main/kotlin/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/core/domain/image/model/ImageFormat.kt` — `ImageFormat.fromTitle(title: String?): ImageFormat?` (line 359) and `val title: String` (line 23) for round-tripping the format.
- Delegation reference: `feature/resize-convert/.../ResizeAndConvertComponent.kt` lines 88-96.

## Step 1: CREATE payload class

`feature/ai-tools/src/main/java/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/feature/ai_tools/domain/model/AiToolsPresetPayload.kt`

```kotlin
package com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.feature.ai_tools.domain.model

data class AiToolsPresetPayload(
    val modelName: String? = null,
    val strength: Float = 65f,
    val chunkSize: Int = 512,
    val overlap: Int = 16,
    val enableChunking: Boolean = true,
    val parallelWorkers: Int = 0,
    val imageFormatTitle: String? = null
)

const val AI_TOOLS_PRESETS_TOOL_KEY = "ai_tools"
```

(Only primitives/String — Moshi-safe. Verify the default values against `NeuralParams.Default` and adjust to match.)

## Step 2: MODIFY `AiToolsComponent.kt`

### 2a. Constructor + delegation

- Add non-assisted constructor parameter `toolPresetsUseCaseFactory: ToolPresetsUseCaseFactory` (import `com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.core.domain.presets.ToolPresetsUseCaseFactory`).
- Append delegation after the supertype:

```kotlin
) : BaseComponent(dispatchersHolder, componentContext),
    ToolPresetsHolder<AiToolsPresetPayload> by ToolPresetsHolder(
        useCase = toolPresetsUseCaseFactory.create(
            toolKey = AI_TOOLS_PRESETS_TOOL_KEY,
            payloadType = AiToolsPresetPayload::class.java
        ),
        componentScope = componentContext.coroutineScope
    ) {
```

Imports: `com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.core.ui.utils.ToolPresetsHolder`, `com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.core.domain.presets.ToolPreset`, and `com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.core.ui.utils.navigation.coroutineScope` (check if already imported).

- In the class body add (factory caches per toolKey, so this is the same instance as the delegate's):

```kotlin
private val aiPresetsUseCase = toolPresetsUseCaseFactory.create(
    toolKey = AI_TOOLS_PRESETS_TOOL_KEY,
    payloadType = AiToolsPresetPayload::class.java
)
```

### 2b. Overrides

```kotlin
override fun saveToolPreset(name: String) {
    componentScope.launch {
        aiPresetsUseCase.upsert(
            ToolPreset(
                name = name,
                payload = AiToolsPresetPayload(
                    modelName = selectedModel.value?.name,
                    strength = params.strength,
                    chunkSize = params.chunkSize,
                    overlap = params.overlap,
                    enableChunking = params.enableChunking,
                    parallelWorkers = params.parallelWorkers,
                    imageFormatTitle = imageFormat?.title
                )
            )
        )
    }
}

override fun applyToolPreset(preset: ToolPreset<AiToolsPresetPayload>) {
    val payload = preset.payload

    payload.modelName?.let { modelName ->
        val model = downloadedModels.value.firstOrNull { it.name == modelName }
        if (model != null) {
            selectModel(model)
        } else {
            AppToastHost.showFailureToast(getString(R.string.model_not_present_in_catalog))
        }
    }

    updateParams {
        copy(
            strength = payload.strength,
            chunkSize = payload.chunkSize,
            overlap = payload.overlap,
            enableChunking = payload.enableChunking,
            parallelWorkers = payload.parallelWorkers
        )
    }

    setImageFormat(ImageFormat.fromTitle(payload.imageFormatTitle))
}
```

NOTES:
- Verify `NeuralParams` field names and adjust `copy(...)` accordingly.
- For the "model not downloaded" toast: `R.string.model_not_present_in_catalog` may not exist. Search `core/resources/src/main/res/values/strings.xml` for an appropriate existing string (candidates: grep for `model_` keys, e.g. `model_already_downloaded`). If nothing fits, use the generic approach: skip the toast entirely and just don't select a model (acceptable fallback — do NOT invent new string keys in this issue).
- `getString` availability: the component already calls `getString(R.string.model_already_downloaded)` (line ~189), so `getString` works inside `componentScope.launch`; if used outside a coroutine and it is suspend, wrap in `componentScope.launch`.
- `AppToastHost` import already exists in this file (used at line ~135).

## Step 3: MODIFY the controls UI

`feature/ai-tools/src/main/java/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/feature/ai_tools/presentation/AiToolsControls.kt` (path may be `.../presentation/components/AiToolsControls.kt` — locate `AiToolsControls.kt` in the module).

Read the file; it renders the settings controls (model selector, params sliders, format selector) and receives the component (or callbacks). Add:

```kotlin
ToolPresetSelector(holder = component)
```

as the FIRST control, with import `com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.core.ui.widget.controls.selection.ToolPresetSelector`. If `AiToolsControls` does not receive the component itself, add the selector instead in the parent content composable (`AiToolsContent.kt`) right above the `AiToolsControls(...)` call, where `component` is in scope. Match surrounding spacing conventions.

## Verification

```
./gradlew :feature:ai-tools:compileMarketDebugKotlin 2>&1 | tail -30
```

(Find exact task via `./gradlew :feature:ai-tools:tasks --all | grep -i compile` if needed.) Must compile. No build.gradle changes expected (module already depends on core:ui/core:domain).

## Acceptance criteria

- Payload file created; component delegates `ToolPresetsHolder<AiToolsPresetPayload>` with both overrides; selector rendered in controls.
- Applying a preset whose model is not downloaded still applies params/format and does not crash.
- Module compiles; no files outside feature/ai-tools modified.

# Final verification: build + QA for tool presets feature

Run after ALL other tool-presets issues are closed.

## 1. Full build

```
./gradlew assembleMarketDebug 2>&1 | tail -40
```

If the `market` flavor does not exist, check `app/build.gradle*` for flavor names (there are typically `market` and `foss` flavors in this project) and build one debug variant. The build MUST succeed. Fix any compilation errors introduced by the preset issues (and only those).

## 2. Lint-level sanity greps (all must return results / hold true)

- `rg "TOOL_PRESETS_" core/data` — storage key prefix present.
- `rg "provideToolPresetsUseCaseFactory" core/data` — DI binding present.
- `rg "ToolPresetsHolder<OcrPresetPayload>" feature/recognize-text` — OCR wired.
- `rg "ToolPresetsHolder<AiToolsPresetPayload>" feature/ai-tools` — AI tools wired.
- `rg "ToolPresetSelector" feature/recognize-text feature/ai-tools` — UI present in both.
- `rg "tool_preset" core/resources/src/main/res/values/strings.xml` — strings present.
- `git diff --stat origin/master... -- feature/resize-convert` (or against the base branch) — MUST be empty; resize-convert untouched.

## 3. Manual QA checklist (emulator/device; document results in a comment on this issue)

OCR tool:
1. Open Recognize Text, change segmentation mode + engine + toggle a preprocessing filter.
2. Open Presets sheet, save as "test-ocr".
3. Change all settings again, apply "test-ocr" — settings restore.
4. Export "test-ocr" to a file; delete the preset; import the file back — preset reappears, success toast shown.

AI Tools:
1. Select a downloaded model, adjust strength/chunk settings, set an image format.

description:
# Epic: Workflows — chain tools into runnable pipelines

## Goal

Let users define named "workflows": an ordered vertical list of tool steps, each step holding a snapshot of that tool's settings (optionally copied from a saved preset). A workflow can be run start-to-finish on one or more images with NO tool UI: share an image to the workflow (in-app picker or Android Direct Share), watch a progress screen, and the result is auto-saved to the default save folder.

## Decisions (already made — do not revisit)

- Step types in v1: **Resize & Convert**, **AI Tools**, **OCR** (OCR only as the LAST step; it outputs a text file next to the image output).
- Preset selection into a step is a **snapshot copy** (payload JSON is copied into the step; later preset edits do NOT affect the workflow). Manual edits to a step clear the shown preset name.
- Share exposure: **both** the in-app tool-picker sheet (`ProcessImagesPreferenceSheet`) and Android **Direct Share** dynamic sharing shortcuts, plus pin-to-launcher shortcuts.
- Run UX: progress screen + auto-save, then offer share of results.

## Architecture

- New Gradle module `:feature:workflows` (mirrors `:feature:ai-tools` structure). It depends on `:feature:ai-tools` and `:feature:recognize-text` for their domain interfaces and preset payload classes. `:feature:root` depends on `:feature:workflows` (same pattern as all other features).
- Domain: `Workflow(id, name, steps)` where `WorkflowStep(toolKey, payloadJson, presetName?)`. Persistence: DataStore Preferences + `JsonParser` (Moshi), mirroring `core/data/src/main/java/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/core/data/presets/ToolPresetsUseCaseImpl.kt`.
- `WorkflowEngine` runs a workflow headlessly using existing UI-independent domain interfaces: `ImageGetter<Bitmap>`, `ImageScaler<Bitmap>`, `ImageTransformer<Bitmap>`, `ImageCompressor<Bitmap>`, `FileController`, `AiToolsRepository<Bitmap>`, `ImageTextReader`.
- 3 new screens in the `Screen` sealed class (`core/ui/.../navigation/Screen.kt`): `Workflows` (id=72, list), `WorkflowEditor` (id=73), `WorkflowRunner` (id=74). Wired through `ChildProvider`/`NavigationChild` in `feature/root`.

## Step payload formats (payloadJson content per toolKey)

| toolKey | payload class | defined in |
|---|---|---|
| `resize_convert` | `ImageExportProfile` | `core/domain/.../image/model/ImageExportProfile.kt` (existing) |
| `ai_tools` | `AiToolsPresetPayload` | `feature/ai-tools/.../domain/model/AiToolsPresetPayload.kt` (existing) |
| `recognize_text` | `OcrStepPayload` (wraps existing `OcrPresetPayload` + output mode) | new, child issue 1 |

toolKey constants MUST equal the existing preset tool keys: `AI_TOOLS_PRESETS_TOOL_KEY == "ai_tools"`, `OCR_PRESETS_TOOL_KEY == "recognize_text"`.

## Hard rules for ALL child issues

1. Every new file gets the Apache license header (copy from any neighboring file, year 2026).
2. Any class serialized with `JsonParser` (Moshi) may ONLY contain: Boolean/Int/Long/Float/Double/String (nullable ok) and List/Map of those, or nested data classes obeying the same rule. NO enums, NO sealed classes, NO value classes, NO Uri/Bitmap.
3. Do NOT modify anything under `feature/resize-convert` or the existing `ImageExportProfilesUseCase`/`ToolPresetsUseCase` implementations (read-only reuse).
4. Mirror existing patterns; when unsure, open the referenced file and copy its structure.
5. Adding new `Screen` subclasses makes several exhaustive `when` expressions fail to compile (ScreenUtils.kt, ScreenSearch.kt, ChildProvider.kt, possibly others). Fixing every compiler error by adding a branch IS part of the task — never add an `else` branch to silence them.
6. Verification for every issue: the stated `./gradlew` command must succeed.

## Child issues (implementation order)

1. Module scaffold + domain model + WorkflowRepository (DataStore) + DI
2. WorkflowEngine: headless pipeline executor with 3 step processors
3. Screens + navigation wiring + Workflows list screen
4. Workflow editor screen (reorder with drag handles, preset snapshot picker, inline settings)
5. Runner screen + in-app share picker integration
6. Direct Share dynamic shortcuts + pin-to-launcher + deeplink routing
7. Final build verification + manual QA + follow-up filing

# Workflows 1/7: module scaffold + domain model + WorkflowRepository + DI

Create the `:feature:workflows` Gradle module with the workflow domain model, DataStore-backed repository, and Hilt wiring. No UI in this issue.

## 1. Register the module

In `settings.gradle.kts`, add (alphabetically among the other `include(":feature:...")` lines, near line 117):

```kotlin
include(":feature:workflows")
```

## 2. Module build file

Create `feature/workflows/build.gradle.kts` — copy `feature/ai-tools/build.gradle.kts` exactly (including license header), then change:

```kotlin
android.namespace = "com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.feature.workflows"

dependencies {
    implementation(projects.feature.aiTools)
    implementation(projects.feature.recognizeText)
}
```

Note: `libs.plugins.image.toolbox.feature` automatically adds all `core.*` dependencies (see `build-logic/convention/src/main/kotlin/ImageToolboxLibraryFeaturePlugin.kt`) — do not add them manually.

Create `feature/workflows/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` — copy `feature/ai-tools/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` verbatim (it is a 62-byte stub).

All Kotlin sources go under `feature/workflows/src/main/java/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/feature/workflows/`.

## 3. Domain model

Create `.../workflows/domain/model/Workflow.kt`:

```kotlin
package com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.feature.workflows.domain.model

data class Workflow(
    val id: String = "",
    val name: String = "",
    val steps: List<WorkflowStep> = emptyList(),
    val version: Int = 1
)

data class WorkflowStep(
    val toolKey: String = "",
    val payloadJson: String = "",
    val presetName: String? = null
)

object WorkflowToolKeys {
    const val RESIZE_CONVERT = "resize_convert"
    const val AI_TOOLS = "ai_tools"           // MUST equal AI_TOOLS_PRESETS_TOOL_KEY
    const val RECOGNIZE_TEXT = "recognize_text" // MUST equal OCR_PRESETS_TOOL_KEY
    val ALL = listOf(RESIZE_CONVERT, AI_TOOLS, RECOGNIZE_TEXT)
}
```

Verify the constants match: `AI_TOOLS_PRESETS_TOOL_KEY` in `feature/ai-tools/src/main/java/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/feature/ai_tools/domain/model/AiToolsPresetPayload.kt` and `OCR_PRESETS_TOOL_KEY` in `feature/recognize-text/src/main/java/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/feature/recognize/text/domain/OcrPresetPayload.kt`. If the actual literals differ, use THEIR values.

Create `.../workflows/domain/model/OcrStepPayload.kt` (the payload stored in `WorkflowStep.payloadJson` when `toolKey == RECOGNIZE_TEXT`):

```kotlin
package com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.feature.workflows.domain.model

import com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.feature.recognize.text.domain.OcrPresetPayload

data class OcrStepPayload(
    val preset: OcrPresetPayload = OcrPresetPayload(),
    val outputMode: String = OUTPUT_MODE_TXT
) {
    companion object {
        const val OUTPUT_MODE_TXT = "txt"
    }
}
```

(If `OcrPresetPayload` has no zero-arg constructor, give every parameter an explicit default matching the defaults used in `RecognizeTextComponent.capturePresetPayload()`.)

Moshi rule: these classes must contain only primitives/String/nullable/List/Map (and nested data classes of the same). Do not add enums or sealed types.

## 4. Repository interface

Create `.../workflows/domain/WorkflowRepository.kt`:

```kotlin
package com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.feature.workflows.domain

import com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.feature.workflows.domain.model.Workflow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow

interface WorkflowRepository {

    val workflows: Flow<List<Workflow>>

    suspend fun getById(id: String): Workflow?

    suspend fun upsert(workflow: Workflow)

    suspend fun delete(id: String)
}
```

## 5. Repository implementation

Create `.../workflows/data/WorkflowRepositoryImpl.kt`. Mirror the structure of `core/data/src/main/java/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/core/data/presets/ToolPresetsUseCaseImpl.kt` (DataStore + JsonParser read/write helpers):

```kotlin
package com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.feature.workflows.data

internal class WorkflowRepositoryImpl @Inject constructor(
    private val dataStore: DataStore<Preferences>,
    private val jsonParser: JsonParser
) : WorkflowRepository {
    // ...
}
```

Details:
- Storage key: `private val WorkflowsKey = stringPreferencesKey("WORKFLOWS_KEY")` (file-level, bottom of file, like `ToolPresetsUseCaseImpl`).
- Wrapper for serialization: `internal data class StoredWorkflows(val workflows: List<Workflow> = emptyList())`. Serialize/deserialize the whole wrapper with `jsonParser.toJson(obj, StoredWorkflows::class.java)` / `jsonParser.fromJson<StoredWorkflows>(json, StoredWorkflows::class.java)`; both return nullable — fall back to `StoredWorkflows()`.
- `workflows`: `dataStore.data.map { it.read().workflows }`.
- `getById`: `workflows.first().find { it.id == id }` (import `kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first`).
- `upsert`: inside `dataStore.edit { ... }`; trim the name; if `workflow.name.isBlank()` return without writing; if `workflow.id.isBlank()` this is a bug in the caller — still write, but generate nothing here (callers create IDs). Replace the element with the same `id` if present, else append.
- `delete`: filter out by `id`; if the resulting list is empty, `remove(WorkflowsKey)` instead of writing `[]` (same as `ToolPresetsUseCaseImpl.writePresets`).
- `DataStore<Preferences>` and `JsonParser` are both already Hilt-injectable app-wide (see `core/data/.../di/LocalModule.kt`).

## 6. DI module

Create `.../workflows/di/WorkflowsModule.kt` — mirror `feature/ai-tools/src/main/java/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/feature/ai_tools/di/AiToolsModule.kt` (same annotations/style):

```kotlin
@Module
@InstallIn(SingletonComponent::class)
internal interface WorkflowsModule {

    @Binds
    @Singleton
    fun bindWorkflowRepository(impl: WorkflowRepositoryImpl): WorkflowRepository
}
```

(Match the exact declaration style of `AiToolsModule` — if it uses `abstract class` + `abstract fun`, do the same.)

## Acceptance criteria

- `./gradlew :feature:workflows:assembleDebug` succeeds.
- `./gradlew :app:assembleFossDebug` still succeeds (nothing else references the module yet).
- No modifications outside `settings.gradle.kts` and `feature/workflows/`.
- Every new file has the 2026 Apache license header.

description:
# Workflows 2/7: WorkflowEngine — headless pipeline executor

Implement the engine that runs a `Workflow` on a list of image URIs with no UI: load image -> apply each step -> auto-save result to the default save folder. Depends on issue 1 (module + domain model).

## 1. Engine contract

Create `feature/workflows/src/main/java/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/feature/workflows/domain/WorkflowEngine.kt`:

```kotlin
package com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.feature.workflows.domain

import com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.feature.workflows.domain.model.Workflow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow

interface WorkflowEngine {
    fun run(workflow: Workflow, uris: List<String>): Flow<WorkflowRunEvent>
}

sealed interface WorkflowRunEvent {
    data class StepStarted(
        val imageIndex: Int,   // 0-based
        val imageCount: Int,
        val stepIndex: Int,    // 0-based
        val stepCount: Int,
        val toolKey: String
    ) : WorkflowRunEvent

    data class StepProgress(          // optional intra-step %, used by AI/OCR steps
        val imageIndex: Int,
        val stepIndex: Int,
        val percent: Int
    ) : WorkflowRunEvent

    data class ImageFailed(
        val imageIndex: Int,
        val stepIndex: Int,
        val toolKey: String,
        val reason: WorkflowFailureReason
    ) : WorkflowRunEvent

    data class ImageDone(
        val imageIndex: Int,
        val savedPath: String?        // human-readable saved location, null if unknown
    ) : WorkflowRunEvent

    data class Finished(
        val successCount: Int,
        val failureCount: Int,
        val savedPaths: List<String>
    ) : WorkflowRunEvent
}

sealed interface WorkflowFailureReason {
    data class ModelNotDownloaded(val modelName: String) : WorkflowFailureReason
    data class Error(val throwable: Throwable) : WorkflowFailureReason
    data object InvalidStep : WorkflowFailureReason
}
```

## 2. Implementation

Create `.../workflows/data/WorkflowEngineImpl.kt`:

```kotlin
internal class WorkflowEngineImpl @Inject constructor(
    private val imageGetter: ImageGetter<Bitmap>,
    private val imageScaler: ImageScaler<Bitmap>,
    private val imageTransformer: ImageTransformer<Bitmap>,
    private val imageCompressor: ImageCompressor<Bitmap>,
    private val fileController: FileController,
    private val jsonParser: JsonParser,
    private val aiToolsRepository: AiToolsRepository<Bitmap>,
    private val imageTextReader: ImageTextReader,
    dispatchersHolder: DispatchersHolder   // check how AiToolsComponent gets dispatchers; if components use a different mechanism, run the flow with flowOn(Dispatchers.Default) instead
) : WorkflowEngine
```

`run()` returns `channelFlow { ... }` (import `kotlinx.coroutines.flow.channelFlow`); use `trySend`/`send` for events; wrap the whole per-image body in `runCatching` so one bad image doesn't kill the run. Apply `.flowOn(Dispatchers.Default)`.

### Per-image algorithm

For each `uri` (index `i`):

1. Load: `val imageData = imageGetter.getImage(uri = uri, originalSize = true, onFailure = null)` -> `ImageData<Bitmap>` with `.image` and `.imageInfo` (see usage in `feature/ai-tools/.../screenLogic/AiToolsComponent.kt:265`). Null -> emit `ImageFailed(..., Error)`, continue with next uri.
2. State: `var bitmap = imageData.image`; `var outInfo = imageData.imageInfo.copy(originalUri = uri)`. `outInfo` carries the OUTPUT format/quality/resize info for the final save.
3. For each step (index `s`), emit `StepStarted`, then dispatch on `step.toolKey`:

**`WorkflowToolKeys.RESIZE_CONVERT`** — payload is `ImageExportProfile` (`core/domain/.../image/model/ImageExportProfile.kt`):
```kotlin
val profile = jsonParser.fromJson<ImageExportProfile>(step.payloadJson, ImageExportProfile::class.java)
    ?: return ImageFailed(InvalidStep)
val base = outInfo.copy(width = bitmap.width, height = bitmap.height)
var target = profile.toImageInfo(base)                       // handles preset-empty vs explicit w/h
target = imageTransformer.applyPresetBy(                     // resolves Preset.Percentage etc. into w/h
    image = bitmap,
    preset = profile.preset,
    currentInfo = target
)
// geometry now, format/quality kept for final compress:
bitmap = imageScaler.scaleImage(
    image = bitmap,
    width = target.width,
    height = target.height,
    resizeType = target.resizeType,
    imageScaleMode = target.imageScaleMode
)
if (target.rotationDegrees != 0f) bitmap = imageTransformer.rotate(bitmap, target.rotationDegrees)
if (target.isFlipped) bitmap = imageTransformer.flip(bitmap, true)
outInfo = target.copy(width = bitmap.width, height = bitmap.height, rotationDegrees = 0f, isFlipped = false)
```
Check the actual field types on `ImageInfo` (`core/domain/.../image/model/ImageInfo.kt`) — e.g. whether `rotationDegrees` is Float or Int — and adapt.

**`WorkflowToolKeys.AI_TOOLS`** — payload is `AiToolsPresetPayload` (`feature/ai-tools/.../domain/model/AiToolsPresetPayload.kt`):
```kotlin
val payload = jsonParser.fromJson<AiToolsPresetPayload>(...) ?: InvalidStep
val model = aiToolsRepository.downloadedModels.value.find { it.name == payload.modelName }
    ?: return ImageFailed(ModelNotDownloaded(payload.modelName ?: ""))
aiToolsRepository.selectModel(model, forced = true)
val result = aiToolsRepository.processImage(
    image = bitmap,
    listener = /* AiProgressListener that forwards percent via StepProgress; read feature/ai-tools/.../domain/AiProgressListener.kt for the exact interface and mirror how AiToolsComponent constructs it */,
    params = NeuralParams(
        strength = payload.strength, chunkSize = payload.chunkSize, overlap = payload.overlap,
        enableChunking = payload.enableChunking, parallelWorkers = payload.parallelWorkers
    )
) ?: return ImageFailed(Error(...))
bitmap = result
payload.imageFormatTitle?.let { title ->
    // mirror how AiToolsComponent.applyToolPreset converts a title back to ImageFormat
    outInfo = outInfo.copy(imageFormat = /* resolved format */)
}
```
Call `aiToolsRepository.cleanup()` in a `finally` after the whole run if AiToolsComponent does so after processing — check and mirror.

**`WorkflowToolKeys.RECOGNIZE_TEXT`** — payload is `OcrStepPayload`. This step MUST be the last one (the editor enforces it; the engine should just process it last if present). It does not change `bitmap`; it produces a `.txt` file:
```kotlin
val payload = jsonParser.fromJson<OcrStepPayload>(...) ?: InvalidStep
val result = imageTextReader.getTextFromImage(
    type = ..., languageCode = ..., recognitionEngine = ..., paddleOCRModel = ...,
    segmentationMode = ..., ocrEngineMode = ..., parameters = ..., model = ...,
    onProgress = { percent -> /* StepProgress */ }
)
```
To fill these parameters from `OcrPresetPayload` (enum names stored as Strings, `tessParams` as Map): read `RecognizeTextComponent.applyToolPreset()` and `RecognizeTextComponent`'s recognition-start function in `feature/recognize-text/.../screenLogic/RecognizeTextComponent.kt` and copy exactly how it converts payload strings -> enums (`toEnumOrNull` helper), builds `TessParams`, joins multiple language codes, and what it passes as `model`. Handle the `TextRecognitionResult` sealed type: on `Success`, save `text` as a `.txt` file — find and mirror how the recognize-text feature saves text to a file headlessly (search `feature/recognize-text` for its save-to-file code path). If the codebase only saves text via user-picked URI, save the txt through `fileController` using the same target type the recognize-text save flow uses. On `Error`/`NoData`, emit `ImageFailed` but STILL save the image result (the image pipeline succeeded).

4. Final save (mirror `AiToolsComponent.kt:286-300`):
```kotlin
val saveResult = fileController.save(
    saveTarget = ImageSaveTarget(
        imageInfo = outInfo.copy(width = bitmap.width, height = bitmap.height),
        originalUri = uri,
        sequenceNumber = i + 1,
        data = imageCompressor.compressAndTransform(
            image = bitmap,
            imageInfo = outInfo.copy(width = bitmap.width, height = bitmap.height)
        )
    ),
    keepOriginalMetadata = false
)
```
Copy the EXACT `ImageSaveTarget` constructor arguments and `fileController.save` signature from `AiToolsComponent` — do not guess. Extract the saved path from `SaveResult.Success` the same way existing components do (search for `is SaveResult.Success` usages) and emit `ImageDone(i, path)`.

5. After all images: emit `Finished(successCount, failureCount, savedPaths)`.

### Validation helper

Add to the interface: `fun validate(workflow: Workflow): List<WorkflowValidationIssue>` where
```kotlin
sealed interface WorkflowValidationIssue {
    data class MissingAiModel(val modelName: String) : WorkflowValidationIssue
    data object EmptyWorkflow : WorkflowValidationIssue
    data object OcrNotLast : WorkflowValidationIssue
    data class UnknownStep(val toolKey: String) : WorkflowValidationIssue
}
```
Implementation checks: steps not empty; every `toolKey` is in `WorkflowToolKeys.ALL`; `RECOGNIZE_TEXT` only at last position; for every AI step, model name exists in `aiToolsRepository.downloadedModels.value`. The runner (issue 5) calls this before `run()`.

## 3. DI

Add to `WorkflowsModule` (issue 1): `@Binds @Singleton fun bindWorkflowEngine(impl: WorkflowEngineImpl): WorkflowEngine`.

Note: `AiToolsRepository<Bitmap>` and `ImageTextReader` are already bound in `SingletonComponent` by `feature/ai-tools/.../di/AiToolsModule.kt` and `feature/recognize-text/.../di/RecognizeTextModule.kt` — just inject them. If `ImageTextReader` injection needs a type parameter or qualifier, copy the injection declaration from `RecognizeTextComponent`'s constructor.

## Acceptance criteria

- `./gradlew :feature:workflows:assembleDebug` succeeds.
- `WorkflowEngineImpl` contains NO Android UI imports (no androidx.compose, no Context except if required by an injected dependency — prefer none).
- All payload parsing failures produce `ImageFailed(InvalidStep)` rather than crashes; engine never throws out of the Flow.
- Events are emitted in the documented order for the happy path: StepStarted (xN) -> ImageDone -> ... -> Finished.

Package: `feature/workflows/src/main/java/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/feature/workflows/presentation/`.

### WorkflowsComponent (`.../presentation/screenLogic/WorkflowsComponent.kt`)

Mirror the structure/annotations of `AiToolsComponent` (AssistedInject + `fun interface Factory`; extends `BaseComponent` — copy the exact superclass constructor call from a simple component like `AiToolsComponent`):

```kotlin
class WorkflowsComponent @AssistedInject internal constructor(
    @Assisted componentContext: ComponentContext,
    @Assisted val onGoBack: () -> Unit,
    @Assisted val onNavigate: (Screen) -> Unit,
    private val workflowRepository: WorkflowRepository,
    dispatchersHolder: DispatchersHolder
) : BaseComponent(dispatchersHolder, componentContext) {

    val workflows: StateFlow<List<Workflow>> = workflowRepository.workflows
        .stateIn(componentScope, SharingStarted.Eagerly, emptyList())

    fun deleteWorkflow(id: String) { componentScope.launch { workflowRepository.delete(id) } }

    fun duplicateWorkflow(workflow: Workflow) {
        componentScope.launch {
            workflowRepository.upsert(
                workflow.copy(id = UUID.randomUUID().toString(), name = workflow.name + " (2)")
            )
        }
    }

    fun interface Factory {
        operator fun invoke(
            componentContext: ComponentContext,
            onGoBack: () -> Unit,
            onNavigate: (Screen) -> Unit,
        ): WorkflowsComponent
    }
}
```

(Adapt to the real `BaseComponent` constructor — open `core/ui`'s `BaseComponent` and one existing component to copy the exact pattern, including `componentScope`.)

- Body: if `workflows` empty -> centered placeholder text `R.string.no_workflows`; else a `LazyColumn` of cards (`PreferenceItem`-style from core/ui widgets) showing workflow name + step count.

# Workflows 4/7: Workflow editor screen (steps, reorder, preset snapshot, inline settings)

Implement the editor: vertical list of steps with right-side drag handles, add/remove steps, pick a preset per step (snapshot copy), and edit key settings inline. Depends on issues 1 and 3.

## Strings

Add to `core/resources/src/main/res/values/strings.xml`:

```xml
<string name="add_step">Add step</string>
<string name="workflow_name">Workflow name</string>
<string name="pick_preset">Pick preset</string>
<string name="no_presets_available">No saved presets for this tool</string>
<string name="step_settings">Step settings</string>
<string name="remove_step">Remove step</string>
<string name="ocr_must_be_last">Text recognition always runs as the last step</string>
<string name="output_mode">Output</string>
<string name="workflow_name_required">Enter a workflow name to save</string>
```

## 1. WorkflowEditorComponent

Replace the issue-3 stub at `feature/workflows/.../presentation/screenLogic/WorkflowEditorComponent.kt`.

Injected: `WorkflowRepository`, `JsonParser`, `ToolPresetsUseCaseFactory` (from `core/domain/.../presets/ToolPresetsUseCaseFactory.kt`), `ImageExportProfilesUseCase` (from `core/domain/.../image/ImageExportProfilesUseCase.kt`), `DispatchersHolder`. Assisted: `componentContext`, `workflowId: String?`, `onGoBack`, `onNavigate`.

State (use `mutableStateOf` fields with private setters, like other components):

- `name: String` — workflow name.
- `steps: List<WorkflowStep>` — the ordered steps (the source of truth is the serialized form; parse payloads on demand for editing).
- `isSaving/isLoaded` as needed.

Init: if `workflowId != null`, load via `repository.getById` and populate; else start with empty name + empty steps and a fresh `id = UUID.randomUUID().toString()` kept in a private field.

Preset sources (for the per-step preset picker):

```kotlin
val resizePresets = imageExportProfilesUseCase.profiles.stateIn(componentScope, Eagerly, emptyList())
private val aiPresetsUseCase = toolPresetsUseCaseFactory.create(AI_TOOLS_PRESETS_TOOL_KEY, AiToolsPresetPayload::class.java)
val aiPresets = aiPresetsUseCase.presets.stateIn(...)
private val ocrPresetsUseCase = toolPresetsUseCaseFactory.create(OCR_PRESETS_TOOL_KEY, OcrPresetPayload::class.java)
val ocrPresets = ocrPresetsUseCase.presets.stateIn(...)
```

Operations (all pure list manipulation on `steps` + `update()` helpers):

- `updateName(String)`
- `addStep(toolKey: String)` — appends a step with the DEFAULT payload serialized via `jsonParser.toJson`: `resize_convert` -> `ImageExportProfile()`, `ai_tools` -> `AiToolsPresetPayload()` (if it has no zero-arg constructor, construct with the same defaults `AiToolsComponent` uses), `recognize_text` -> `OcrStepPayload()`. After append, call `normalizeOcrLast()`.
- `removeStep(index: Int)`
- `moveStep(from: Int, to: Int)` — then `normalizeOcrLast()`.
- `normalizeOcrLast()` — if a step with `toolKey == RECOGNIZE_TEXT` exists, move it to the end (there can be at most one; `addStep` must ignore a second OCR request — the UI disables the option too).
- `applyPresetToStep(index: Int, presetName: String, payloadJson: String)` — replaces `steps[index]` payload with the preset's serialized payload and sets `presetName`. For resize presets serialize the `ImageExportProfile` object; for ai/ocr the `ToolPreset<T>.payload`. NOTE for OCR: preset payload type is `OcrPresetPayload` but the STEP stores `OcrStepPayload` — wrap: `OcrStepPayload(preset = payload, outputMode = currentOutputMode)`.
- `updateStepPayload(index: Int, payloadJson: String)` — manual edit path; sets `presetName = null` (snapshot semantics: edits detach the preset label).
- `save()` — requires `name` non-blank (expose an error flag consumed by UI showing `workflow_name_required`); `repository.upsert(Workflow(id, name.trim(), steps))`; then `onGoBack()`.

Typed payload accessors for the UI (parse/serialize helpers using `jsonParser`):

```kotlin
fun resizePayload(step: WorkflowStep): ImageExportProfile?
fun aiPayload(step: WorkflowStep): AiToolsPresetPayload?
fun ocrPayload(step: WorkflowStep): OcrStepPayload?
```

## 2. WorkflowEditorContent

Replace the stub. Layout (top -> bottom):

1. Top bar: back (confirm-discard not required in v1), title = workflow name or `R.string.workflow_editor`, Save action button calling `component.save()`.
2. `RoundedTextField` (core/ui widget — find existing usage) for `workflow_name`.
3. Reorderable step list. Use the `sh.calvin.reorderable` library ALREADY used in this project. Copy the pattern from `core/ui/src/main/kotlin/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/core/ui/widget/controls/FileReorderVerticalList.kt` (lines ~95, ~231): `rememberReorderableLazyListState` + `ReorderableItem`, with the drag handle modifier applied to a handle icon (`Icons.Rounded.DragHandle`) placed at the RIGHT edge of each step card (`draggableHandle()` modifier from the library — see how FileReorderVerticalList attaches it).
4. Each step card shows:
   - Leading: tool icon + tool name. Map toolKey -> (icon, title): `resize_convert` -> `Screen.ResizeAndConvert()` title/icon, `ai_tools` -> `Screen.AiTools()`, `recognize_text` -> `Screen.RecognizeText()` (reuse the Screen icon extension from `ScreenUtils.kt`).
   - A preset chip: shows `step.presetName ?: stringResource(R.string.pick_preset)`. Click opens a bottom sheet (`EnhancedModalBottomSheet` — copy usage from `core/ui/.../controls/selection/ToolPresetSelector.kt`) listing preset names for that step's tool from the matching StateFlow; empty state shows `no_presets_available`. Selecting calls `applyPresetToStep`.
   - An expand/collapse toggle revealing inline settings (see below).
   - Overflow/delete icon -> `removeStep` (with small confirm or direct — direct is fine).
   - If the card is the OCR step, show a small caption `ocr_must_be_last` and do not allow dragging it (skip the drag handle for this card).
5. "Add step" button at the bottom of the list -> bottom sheet with 3 options (Resize & Convert / AI Tools / OCR), each rendered with the tool icon+name; OCR option disabled (alpha 0.5, no click) when an OCR step already exists.

### Inline settings per step (v1 scope — deliberately minimal; full parity is a follow-up)

All editors operate by parsing the payload, rendering controls, and writing back through `updateStepPayload` on every change.

- **resize_convert** (`ImageExportProfile`): two number text fields Width/Height (`RoundedTextField`, digits only) bound to `imageInfo.width/height`; `QualitySelector` and `ImageFormatSelector` from `core/ui/.../controls/selection/` bound to `imageInfo.quality`/`imageInfo.imageFormat` — copy their parameter usage from `feature/resize-convert/.../ResizeAndConvertContent.kt`.
- **ai_tools** (`AiToolsPresetPayload`): read-only row showing `modelName ?: "—"` (model choice comes from presets); `EnhancedSliderItem` (find existing usages in core/ui) for `strength` (0..100); sliders/steppers for `chunkSize` (allowed: 128/256/512/1024/2048) and `overlap` (16/32/64/128) — a simple `EnhancedChipGroup`/segmented row of the allowed values is acceptable; switch for `enableChunking`; stepper 0..8 for `parallelWorkers`.
- **recognize_text** (`OcrStepPayload`): read-only summary of engine + languages from the wrapped preset (strings straight from payload fields); the only editable control is `outputMode` — v1 has a single value ("txt"), so render a disabled selector labeled `output_mode: TXT`. Everything else is configured by picking an OCR preset.

## Acceptance criteria

- `./gradlew :app:assembleFossDebug` succeeds.
- Manual: create workflow "Test": add Resize step, add AI step, add OCR step; OCR pins to bottom and cannot be dragged; reorder Resize/AI via right-side handle; pick an AI preset -> chip shows preset name; tweak strength -> chip label resets to "Pick preset" (presetName cleared); Save; reopen from list -> everything persisted.
- Adding a second OCR step is impossible (option disabled).
- Saving with empty name is blocked with the `workflow_name_required` message.

# Workflows 5/7: Runner screen + in-app share picker integration

Implement the run screen (progress + auto-save + share results) and surface workflows in the sheet shown when images are shared to the app. Depends on issues 2 and 3.

## Strings

Add to `core/resources/src/main/res/values/strings.xml`:

```xml
<string name="running_workflow">Running workflow</string>
<string name="workflow_step_of">Step %1$d of %2$d</string>
<string name="workflow_image_of">Image %1$d of %2$d</string>
<string name="workflow_done">Workflow finished</string>
<string name="workflow_saved_to">Saved: %1$s</string>
<string name="workflow_failed_images">%1$d image(s) failed</string>
<string name="workflow_model_missing">AI model "%1$s" is not downloaded. Open AI Tools to download it.</string>
<string name="workflow_invalid">This workflow has invalid steps. Edit it and try again.</string>
<string name="run_again">Run again</string>
```

## 1. WorkflowRunnerComponent

Replace the issue-3 stub at `feature/workflows/.../presentation/screenLogic/WorkflowRunnerComponent.kt`.

Injected: `WorkflowRepository`, `WorkflowEngine`, `ImageShareProvider<Bitmap>` or the plain `ShareProvider` (`core/domain/.../image/ShareProvider.kt`) for sharing saved results — check which existing component shares a list of saved file URIs (search `shareUris`) and mirror. Assisted: `componentContext`, `workflowId: String`, `initialUris: List<Uri>?`, `onGoBack`, `onNavigate`.

State:

```kotlin
sealed interface RunnerState {
    data object Loading : RunnerState
    data object AwaitingImages : RunnerState                       // no uris passed; show picker CTA
    data class Invalid(val issues: List<WorkflowValidationIssue>) : RunnerState
    data class Running(
        val imageIndex: Int, val imageCount: Int,
        val stepIndex: Int, val stepCount: Int,
        val toolKey: String, val stepPercent: Int?
    ) : RunnerState
    data class Done(
        val savedPaths: List<String>, val failureCount: Int
    ) : RunnerState
}
```

Expose `val state: MutableState<RunnerState>` (private set) and `val workflow: MutableState<Workflow?>`.

Logic:

- `init`: load workflow (`getById`); if null -> toast + `onGoBack`. If `initialUris` is non-empty -> `startRun(initialUris)`; else state = `AwaitingImages`.
- `startRun(uris: List<Uri>)`:
  1. `engine.validate(workflow)` — if issues, state = `Invalid(issues)` and stop. Map `MissingAiModel` to `workflow_model_missing` text in UI; provide a button navigating to `Screen.AiTools()` via `onNavigate`.
  2. Collect `engine.run(workflow, uris.map { it.toString() })` in `componentScope`, mapping events to state:
     - `StepStarted` -> `Running(...)` (stepPercent = null)
     - `StepProgress` -> update `stepPercent`
     - `ImageDone` / `ImageFailed` -> accumulate
     - `Finished` -> `Done(savedPaths, failureCount)`
- `shareResults()` — share the saved files; mirror how an existing component shares already-saved URIs (search for `shareProvider.shareUris` / `shareData` usages). If `savedPaths` are display paths rather than URIs, capture the actual URIs from `SaveResult` in issue 2's `ImageDone` event instead (extend the event with `savedUri: String?` if needed — coordinate: it is fine to add the field in this issue).
- `runAgain()` — reset and rerun with the same uris (keep last uris in a field).

Keep the screen alive during processing the same way long-running components do (check how `AiToolsComponent` prevents back navigation / keeps work running — if there is a `KeepAlive`/foreground-service helper in use, mirror it; if not, skip).

## 2. WorkflowRunnerContent

Replace the stub. UI:

- Top bar: workflow name; back button (if Running, show a confirm dialog "stop processing?" — reuse an existing `EnhancedAlertDialog` pattern from core/ui).
- `AwaitingImages`: big pick-images button. Use the standard image picker helper used by tool screens (search core/ui for `rememberImagePicker` or `Picker` usages in e.g. `AiToolsContent`) -> on result call `component.startRun(uris)`.
- `Running`: workflow name, `workflow_image_of` + `workflow_step_of` texts, current step's tool name + icon (same toolKey->Screen mapping as the editor), `LinearProgressIndicator` — overall progress = (completed steps)/(imageCount*stepCount), plus indeterminate or percent bar for `stepPercent`.
- `Invalid`: list issue messages; button "Edit" -> `onNavigate(Screen.WorkflowEditor(workflowId))`; for `MissingAiModel` also button to `Screen.AiTools()`.
- `Done`: success icon, `workflow_done`, list of `workflow_saved_to` entries (one per saved path, ellipsized), `workflow_failed_images` row when failureCount > 0, buttons: Share (-> `component.shareResults()`), `run_again`, Close (-> `onGoBack`).

## 3. In-app share picker integration

Goal: when the user shares images to ImageToolbox and the tool-picker sheet appears, workflows are listed at the top.

`ProcessImagesPreferenceSheet` lives in `core/ui` (`core/ui/.../widget/sheets/ProcessImagesPreferenceSheet.kt:110`) and cannot depend on `feature/workflows`, so pass data in:

1. In `core/ui/.../utils/navigation/` add a tiny model (new file `WorkflowShareEntry.kt`):
   ```kotlin
   data class WorkflowShareEntry(val id: String, val name: String)
   ```
2. Add parameter to `ProcessImagesPreferenceSheet`: `workflows: List<WorkflowShareEntry> = emptyList()`. When non-empty AND `extraDataType` is null (plain images), render a "Workflows" header + one row per entry ABOVE the tool grid (reuse the same item composable style used for screens in that sheet, with the Workflows screen icon). Row click: `onNavigate(Screen.WorkflowRunner(entry.id, uris))` and dismiss (mirror how tool rows invoke `onNavigate`).
3. `RootComponent` (`feature/root/.../screenLogic/RootComponent.kt`): inject `WorkflowRepository`, expose
   ```kotlin
   val workflows: StateFlow<List<Workflow>> = workflowRepository.workflows.stateIn(...)
   ```
4. `RootDialogs.kt` (`feature/root/.../components/RootDialogs.kt:49`): pass `workflows = component.workflows.collectAsState().value.map { WorkflowShareEntry(it.id, it.name) }` into `ProcessImagesPreferenceSheet`.

## Acceptance criteria

- `./gradlew :app:assembleFossDebug` succeeds.
- Manual: from Workflows list, tap Run on a workflow -> picker -> select 2 images -> progress advances through steps/images -> Done screen lists 2 saved files; files exist in the default save folder.
- Share 1 image from another app to ImageToolbox -> picker sheet shows "Workflows" section on top -> tapping a workflow runs it on the shared image with no further input and auto-saves.
- Workflow with an AI step whose model is not downloaded shows the `workflow_model_missing` state BEFORE processing starts, with a working link to AI Tools.

description:
# Workflows 6/7: Direct Share targets, pin-to-launcher shortcuts, deeplink routing

Expose each workflow as an Android Direct Share target (system share sheet) and allow pinning a workflow to the launcher. Route those intents to `Screen.WorkflowRunner`. Depends on issue 5.

Background: today the app has NO dynamic shortcuts and NO share-targets — only pin shortcuts created by `Context.createScreenShortcut` (`core/ui/.../utils/helper/ContextUtils.kt:340`, using `SHORTCUT_OPEN_ACTION = "shortcut"` + `SCREEN_ID_EXTRA` int extra, handled in `HandleDeeplinks.kt` via `getScreenOpeningShortcut`, `ContextUtils.kt:324`).

## 1. Constants

In `core/ui/.../utils/helper/ContextUtils.kt` next to `SHORTCUT_OPEN_ACTION` (line ~302) add:

```kotlin
const val WORKFLOW_ID_EXTRA = "workflow_id"
const val WORKFLOW_SHORTCUT_PREFIX = "workflow_"
const val WORKFLOW_SHARE_CATEGORY = "com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.WORKFLOW_SHARE_TARGET"
```

## 2. Static share-target declaration

Create `app/src/main/res/xml/shortcuts.xml`:

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<shortcuts xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">
    <share-target android:targetClass="com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.app.presentation.AppActivity">
        <data android:mimeType="image/*" />
        <category android:name="com.t8rin.imagetoolbox.WORKFLOW_SHARE_TARGET" />
    </share-target>
</shortcuts>
```

Verify the activity FQCN: `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` line ~94 declares `.app.presentation.AppActivity`; resolve against the manifest `package`/namespace in `app/build.gradle.kts` and use the fully-qualified result in `targetClass`.

In `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`, inside the `<activity>` element for AppActivity, add:

```xml
<meta-data
    android:name="android.app.shortcuts"
    android:resource="@xml/shortcuts" />
```

## 3. Dynamic sharing shortcuts publisher

Create `feature/workflows/src/main/java/com/t8rin/imagetoolbox/feature/workflows/data/WorkflowShortcutsUpdater.kt`:

```kotlin
@Singleton
internal class WorkflowShortcutsUpdater @Inject constructor(
    @ApplicationContext private val context: Context
) {
    fun update(workflows: List<Workflow>) { ... }
}
```

`update` builds one `ShortcutInfoCompat` per workflow (cap the list at `ShortcutManagerCompat.getMaxShortcutCountPerActivity(context).coerceAtMost(4)`; take the first N):

- `setId(WORKFLOW_SHORTCUT_PREFIX + workflow.id)`
- `setShortLabel(workflow.name.ifBlank { "Workflow" })`, `setLongLabel(workflow.name)`
- `setIcon(...)` — reuse the same icon-creation approach as `createScreenShortcut` (`ContextUtils.kt:340`) with the Workflows screen icon.
- `setCategories(setOf(WORKFLOW_SHARE_CATEGORY))`
- `setIntent(Intent(context, AppActivityClass).apply { action = Intent.ACTION_SEND; putExtra(WORKFLOW_ID_EXTRA, workflow.id) })` — `AppActivityClass` is the same reference `createScreenShortcut` uses; an explicit action is REQUIRED by ShortcutInfoCompat. Then `ShortcutManagerCompat.setDynamicShortcuts(context, list)` (replaces all — fine since the app has no other dynamic shortcuts). Wrap in `runCatching` (some launchers throw).

Call sites: in `WorkflowRepositoryImpl` (issue 1), inject `WorkflowShortcutsUpdater` and call `updater.update(newList)` at the end of `upsert` and `delete` (after the DataStore edit), plus once from an `init`-time refresh: launch on first `workflows` emission (use a `CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Default)` field or better: expose `suspend fun refresh()` called by `RootComponent` init — choose the simplest that compiles; direct calls after edit + no init refresh is acceptable for v1).

Note: `feature/workflows` needs no new dependency for `ShortcutManagerCompat` if `androidx.core` is already on the classpath via core modules (it is — `ContextUtils.kt` uses it from `core/ui`).

## 4. Deeplink routing

Edit `core/ui/.../utils/helper/HandleDeeplinks.kt` (`Intent?.handleDeeplinks`, line ~36). Add BEFORE the generic `ACTION_SEND` handling:

```kotlin
// Direct Share into a workflow: system share sheet sets EXTRA_SHORTCUT_ID;
// pinned workflow shortcuts carry WORKFLOW_ID_EXTRA directly.
val workflowId = intent?.getStringExtra(WORKFLOW_ID_EXTRA)
    ?: intent?.getStringExtra(Intent.EXTRA_SHORTCUT_ID)
        ?.takeIf { it.startsWith(WORKFLOW_SHORTCUT_PREFIX) }
        ?.removePrefix(WORKFLOW_SHORTCUT_PREFIX)
if (workflowId != null) {
    val uris = /* extract stream uris exactly the way the existing ACTION_SEND / ACTION_SEND_MULTIPLE branches do (EXTRA_STREAM single + multiple) */
    onNavigate(Screen.WorkflowRunner(workflowId, uris?.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }))
    return  /* match the function's existing early-exit style */
}
```

Follow the function's existing structure/style (it may be an expression body or use `when` — integrate accordingly). Pinned-shortcut launches have no uris -> Runner opens in `AwaitingImages` state (already implemented in issue 5).

## 5. Pin-to-launcher from the Workflows list

In `core/ui/.../utils/helper/ContextUtils.kt`, add next to `createScreenShortcut` (line ~340), copying its structure:

```kotlin
fun Context.createWorkflowShortcut(
    workflowId: String,
    label: String,
    icon: ImageVector /* same params style as createScreenShortcut */
)
```

Differences from `createScreenShortcut`: id = `WORKFLOW_SHORTCUT_PREFIX + workflowId`; intent = `Intent(this, AppActivityClass).apply { action = SHORTCUT_OPEN_ACTION; putExtra(WORKFLOW_ID_EXTRA, workflowId) }`; label = workflow name. Everything else (icon rendering, `requestPinShortcut`, error handling) identical.

Then in `WorkflowsContent` (issue 3 file), add an "Add to home screen" action to each workflow card's overflow menu calling `context.createWorkflowShortcut(...)` (get context via `LocalContext.current` / the project's `LocalComponentActivity` helper — mirror how `MainTopAppBar.kt:181` triggers `createScreenShortcut`).

Also ensure the `SHORTCUT_OPEN_ACTION` path doesn't swallow workflow intents: `getScreenOpeningShortcut` (`ContextUtils.kt:324`) looks up `SCREEN_ID_EXTRA`; workflow shortcuts don't set it, but verify it returns null (not crashes) when absent, and that the new workflow branch in `handleDeeplinks` runs FIRST for intents carrying `WORKFLOW_ID_EXTRA` regardless of action.

## Acceptance criteria

- `./gradlew :app:assembleFossDebug` succeeds; app installs with no manifest merge errors.
- After creating 2 workflows, sharing an image from another app shows both as Direct Share targets (name + app icon) on a launcher/OS supporting sharing shortcuts (API 29+); tapping one opens the Runner already processing the shared image.
- Deleting a workflow removes its Direct Share target (next share sheet open).
- "Add to home screen" pins a shortcut; tapping it opens the Runner in pick-images state.
- Sharing text (non-image) does not surface workflow targets (mimeType filter).

# Workflows 7/7: final build verification + manual QA + follow-up filing

Final gate for the Workflows epic. Depends on issues 4, 5, 6.

## 1. Build verification

```bash
./gradlew :feature:workflows:assembleDebug
./gradlew :app:assembleFossDebug
./gradlew :app:assembleMarketDebug
```

If detekt is part of the standard verification for feature modules (check how CI/gradle wires it), run it for `:feature:workflows` and fix findings.

## 2. Manual QA checklist (device/emulator, API 29+)

Creation/editing:
- [ ] Main screen shows "Workflows" tile in Tools group; search finds it via "pipeline".
- [ ] Create workflow: name + Resize step (50% quality 80 WEBP via inline edit) + AI step (pick preset) + OCR step; OCR pinned last, drag handle reorders Resize/AI only.
- [ ] Save, reopen: all steps and settings persist. Duplicate and Delete work; delete shows confirm with workflow name.
- [ ] Editing a step field clears its preset chip label (snapshot semantics).
- [ ] Second OCR step cannot be added.

Running:
- [ ] Run from list -> picker -> 2 images -> progress shows image x/2 and step x/N -> Done lists 2 saved files present in default save folder with correct format/size.
- [ ] OCR step produced .txt file(s) with recognized text.
- [ ] AI step with missing model: validation screen appears BEFORE processing; link opens AI Tools.
- [ ] Share button on Done screen shares the produced files.

Share/shortcuts:
- [ ] Share image from Photos -> ImageToolbox picker sheet shows Workflows section on top; tapping runs end-to-end with zero further taps (auto-save).
- [ ] Direct Share: workflow names appear as targets in the system share sheet; tapping processes the shared image start-to-finish.
- [ ] Pin to home screen -> launcher shortcut opens Runner in pick-images state.
- [ ] Deleted workflow disappears from Direct Share targets.
